series: Walkthrough for the bank Short shipping-mug-13-19.json, built Oct 7, 2026 for CMO review
hook: $4.95 shipping on a mug that costs $13.19 to send
hook_say: This video shows the true cost of shipping one 12 ounce mug from an Etsy or eBay shop, and what to charge so shipping stops eating the sale.

rows.label: Ceramic mug, 12 oz
rows.why: The example product is a 12 ounce ceramic mug that sells for $19. Packed, it weighs 18 ounces in an 8 by 6 by 6 inch box, going to zone 5.

rows.label: Shipping you charge
rows.why: The listing charges the buyer $4.95 for shipping. This is the number the sheet tests against the real cost.

rows.label: Postage, cheapest service
rows.why: The sheet bills the box at 2 pounds and checks each service at zone 5. The cheapest is USPS Ground Advantage Commercial at $9.95, against $14.10 at the post office counter.

rows.label: Box, filler, tape, label
rows.why: Packing materials count too: an 85 cent box, 45 cents of filler, 8 cents of tape and a 6 cent label. That is $1.44 a parcel.

rows.label: Packing, 6 min at $18 an hour
rows.why: And your time. Six minutes of packing at $18 an hour is $1.80, a cost that never shows up on a label.

rows.label: True cost per parcel
rows.why: Add postage, materials and packing time: $13.19 to send one mug. Postage is about 75% of it.

rows.label: Short on every parcel
rows.say: You are $8.24 short on every one
rows.why: The buyer paid $4.95, so every mug that ships is $8.24 short. On a $19 mug, that comes straight out of the price.

fix.label: Charge $13.95 shipping
fix.say: Charge $13.95 and the mug is covered
fix.why: Charge $13.95 for shipping and the check reads Covered, with 76 cents to spare on every parcel.

A 12 ounce mug charged $4.95 shipping really costs $13.19 to send once postage, box, filler, tape, label and packing time are counted. That leaves every parcel $8.24 short. Example numbers from the Etsy and eBay Shipping Cost Calculator; yours go in the yellow cells.
